description:
**Team BÖVD** 🌌
> Our name comes from the Boötes Void, one of the largest empty regions in the universe. Astronauts face their own kind of void: far from home, with no doctor in the room. We're building BÖVD, an AI health monitor for astronauts that reads live data from NASA's ISS feed (cabin oxygen, CO₂, pressure and temperature) and shows how the station's environment affects the crew's vitals.
